notes: Defect: promo code discount amount not displayed for return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmation. The discount mapping flows through mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch (which constructs the discount object sent to Mozio) and generate-staff-notes.mappers (which calculates per-unit discount and multiplies by quantity, with isReturnTrip/isReturnTicket flags). The return-trip station swap in create-reservations.mappers may also affect which dispatch the discount is attached to. The bug likely resides in how discount data is propagated for the return-trip dispatch — either the discount field is omitted/undefined on the return dispatch, or the per-unit discount calculation for return tickets is zeroed out.
